For context I’m a thirty six year old women, my sister is thirty four. My sister has three kids with her ex husband and I have four with my husband. This entire saga traumatized my younger sister and the divorce was rough. I’m completely disgusted with my ex brother in law and so is my entire inner family. We’ve completely cut contact with him. I stood by firmly and my husband agreed with me. Her kids got upset that I didn’t want their dad at any events and my kids now hate their ex uncle (even though I haven’t ever spoken to them about the situation). My sister got upset and says that she can fight her own battles and that banning him makes me an asshole. My sister has always allowed this guy to walk all over her and always defends him. Am I wrong for not wanting him at events and parties I throw? I just don’t see it.
